title: Jubilant Citrusy Norwegian Sloe Berry Crumble
description: A festive and citrusy Norwegian dessert featuring sloe berries, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly crumble is perfect for special occasions. The combination of sloe berries, orange zest, and lemon juice creates a unique and delicious flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sloe berries, granulated sugar, and lemon juice.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, rolled oats, and brown sugar.
Add the melted butter to the dry ingredients and mix until crumbly.
Stir in the orange zest and beaten eggs.
Pour the sloe berry mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Top the sloe berry mixture with the crumbly mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
